findings.problem: Value column misaligned: label+padding is 11 cells vs 14 in the sibling relay rows (and the English, where every row aligns at 14). Context note says the padding aligns the column.
findings.suggested: "  इंस्टॉल:     {value}\n" padded so {value} starts at cell 14 (e.g. 5 spaces after the colon; verify with cell_len)

findings.problem: Value column at 13 cells, sibling rows at 14; one space short, so the identity value is visibly offset.
findings.suggested: "  पहचान:       {identity}\n" (one more space; value at cell 14)

findings.problem: "अलग से" is an adverb ("separately"), not a name for the card; existing hi copy names the same aside surface "नोट" (tui.notices.unsaved_asides, wire.errors.desktop.aside_*), so one feature now has two names.
findings.suggested: Align with the shipped term: "नोट" — or, if "नोट" is to be replaced, a noun such as "अलग बातचीत" applied to all aside keys at once

findings.problem: "वार्तालाप" diverges from the settled hi term for conversation, "बातचीत" (102 uses in shipped hi catalogues).

findings.english: {count, plural, one {{shown} question waiting} other {{shown} questions waiting}}
findings.current: {count, plural, one {{shown} प्रश्न प्रतीक्षा में} other {{shown} प्रश्न प्रतीक्षा में}}
findings.problem: "प्रश्न" for an ask/question diverges from shipped hi copy, which uses "सवाल" (22 uses, e.g. relay.ask.*, relay.asks.*); same for ask_queue.question_timed_out.
findings.suggested: "{count, plural, one {{shown} सवाल प्रतीक्षा में} other {{shown} सवाल प्रतीक्षा में}}" (and question_timed_out: "सवाल का/सवालों का समय समाप्त")

findings.problem: "टूडू" is a bare transliteration that does not read as Hindi; a short native heading fits.

Alignment fix verified under rich.cell_len, which the style guide mandates: {value} lands at cell 14 for installed_row and identity_row, the same as the relay rows. A wcwidth-style count that gives spacing matras (Mc: ा U+093E, ॉ U+0949) width 1 puts both rows at 15, one cell to the right. The rule is met; whether a given terminal renders them aligned depends on how it handles Mc. No change is requested.
findings.suggested: none (keep); verify on a rendered frame when the panel is visually validated
findings.disposition: open at PASS: minor/nit accepted, value unchanged

findings.problem: todo → कार्य/कार्य सूची is idiomatic. But bare कार्य also renders task/work elsewhere in this set (cli.exec_help.background 'कार्य को अलग करें', wire.console.*), so in todos_counts ' · कार्य {open}/{total}' and more_todos '… {count} और कार्य' a todo count can read as a task count.
findings.suggested: optional: ' · कार्य सूची {open}/{total}' / '… {count} और कार्य-सूची आइटम' if space allows
findings.disposition: open at PASS: minor/nit accepted, value unchanged
